labels.source: Mounted ViT Co/Metallist Russian disc FONT16 (Cyrillic) and existing shipped PAL FONT16 (English). Rendered at original glyph scale, locally upscaled 4x with Real-ESRGAN realesrgan-x4plus, grayscale alpha extracted. No replacement typeface.
labels.rights: Derived game letterforms; no new copyright license is asserted over underlying game resources.

backgrounds.title-us.png: User-supplied 1448x1086 reconstruction/upscale of the original US title alley. Copied without additional processing.
backgrounds.title-us-wide.png: User-supplied 1672x940 widescreen adaptation of the same alley, with repositioned SILENT HILL logo. Copied without additional processing.
backgrounds.title-pal.png: Existing shipped PAL title TIM, locally upscaled 4x with Real-ESRGAN realesrgan-x4plus.
backgrounds.side-left.png, side-right.png: Blurred narrow unlettered edge strips from the user-supplied 4:3 composition; only used outside contained art.
backgrounds.rights: Derived original-game artwork. User requested inclusion as a separate optional-art commit; no ownership or new license over underlying game imagery is asserted. Can be dropped independently; renderer falls back to disc art.
